ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a ratio of approximately 95% dark to 5% high-intensity (white) localized points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark gray to black field across both lobes. Spatial distribution of high-intensity pixels is restricted to circular ring-shaped clusters scattered sparsely across the mid-section and dense, irregular white clusters at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 42 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1:4 relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and narrow valleys along the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed curve exhibiting concavity starting from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the mid-lobe, and terminating in a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white rings (diameter ~5-15 pixels) distributed across the central and outer fluke surface, particularly prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white calcified barnacle clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; numerous circular depigmentation marks (rosettes) across the ventral surface.
